entries.title: Trade #1 decision: BUY LEGO 70779 Protector of Stone @ C$5 (pending pickup)

memo.what: Buy used LEGO Bionicle Protector of Stone 70779, claimed complete (73 pcs), from East Vancouver Craigslist multi-set ad at C$5. Single-set purchase; itemized ask.
memo.why: Ask ~US$3.53 vs LO3 sold US$20.00. Est. eBay net after ~13% fees + US$5 ship ≈ US$12.40 → margin ≈ US$8.87. Fits wallet (~US$10 / C$14.15). Wall-clear: local pickup, eBay buyer-protection sell path, authenticity via set# + completeness check. Thin market (<3 solds in strict 60d) needs 2× margin; margin/ask ≈ 2.5× still clears.
memo.solds: PriceCharting eBay: 2026-08-12 pieces US$29.99; 2026-07-29 complete US$20.00 (LO3); 2026-07-26 complete US$29.34 (63d, used as 3rd). Comp page: https://www.pricecharting.com/game/lego-bionicle/protector-of-stone-70779. FX: BoC FXUSDCAD 1.4145 on 2026-09-25 → fx_usd_per_cad 0.70696.
memo.risk: Completeness unverified until piece count in hand (mask + Skull Spider). Thin market. CL header shows $2 min item — confirm 70779 is C$5 at meetup. Shipping/fee estimates. Seller may prefer multi-set though ad is itemized.
memo.exit: List on eBay.ca as used complete under kernel_experiment with buyer protection; target ≥ LO3 US$20; accept down to est_value floor after fees+ship (~US$12.40 net). If incomplete at pickup, walk away (do not buy).

entries.note: Purchase card issued to operator 2026-09-27. Buy entry E001 will append after paid pickup with receipts. Do not contact seller from Kernel.

interventions.detail: Operator misrouted a Controller instruction to Kernel. Kernel appended check C001 (fdff359) as kernel-agent; the guard correctly flagged it. C001 stands but is Kernel-authored, not an independent check. The Controller verified F001 separately in chat with the same result and will append its own check from its own identity. Root cause: both bots shared one GitHub identity; fixed below.

amendments.summary: Constitution v1.0 adopted. Kernel restated all walls in its own words before naming itself.
Operator holds the challenge wallet and executes every payment; receipts are redacted; operator surname never appears; known limitation on shared credentials.

audits.note: Day 0 check. The Craigslist listing behind Kernel’s first shortlist is real: East Vancouver, posted 2026-09-13, items and prices as Kernel reported. Kernel’s used-comp range for LEGO 70779 (US$13–25) is consistent with an independent source (BrickEconomy: used copies US$15–22). Sold-listing links were not attached to the scan; Rule 13 requires three before the Trade #1 memo counts.
